faqs.q: Can you integrate AI into an existing .NET application?
faqs.a: Yes. This is the core of what I do. AI capabilities like chat interfaces, document search, and intelligent automation can be added as a new layer on top of your existing .NET application — without rebuilding it. The integration typically involves connecting your application to an LLM through APIs, linking it to your existing database, and adding the necessary business logic.

faqs.q: Can AI connect to an existing database?
faqs.a: Absolutely. AI can be connected to your existing SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or other databases. Using techniques like RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and function-calling AI agents, the AI can query your database, retrieve relevant information, and use it to provide intelligent, context-aware responses.

faqs.q: Can I use my company's private documents with an LLM?
faqs.a: Yes. Using RAG, your private documents are processed into embeddings and stored in a vector database. When a user asks a question, the system retrieves the most relevant document sections and passes them to the LLM as context. Your documents stay private — they are not used to train the model.

faqs.q: Can you build a proof of concept?
faqs.a: Yes. I offer proof of concept (PoC) development to help you validate an AI idea before committing to a full implementation. A PoC typically covers a focused use case — for example, a document search assistant or a simple AI chatbot connected to your data — so you can see real results quickly and make an informed decision.

faqs.q: Can you integrate OpenAI into an existing application?
faqs.a: Yes. OpenAI integration is one of the most common requests. This involves connecting your application to OpenAI APIs (such as GPT models), handling authentication, managing prompts, processing responses, and integrating the results into your existing user interface and business logic.

Yes. AI agents can be built to perform tasks beyond simple text generation. An AI agent can use your APIs, query databases, execute business workflows, and make decisions based on the results. This is useful for automating multi-step processes that currently require manual intervention.

faqs.q: Can AI work with existing REST APIs?
faqs.a: Yes. AI agents and LLMs with function-calling capabilities can interact with your existing REST APIs. This allows the AI to fetch data, trigger actions, and integrate with third-party services as part of its response generation — essentially giving the AI the ability to use your existing software as tools.

faqs.q: What information do you need before starting a project?
faqs.a: To get started, it helps to have: a description of your existing application or idea, the technology stack you are using, the specific business problem you want to solve with AI, and any constraints around data privacy, budget, or timeline. The more context you can provide, the faster we can move from idea to implementation.
